industry: Consumer Discretionary > Realty > Residential, Commercial Projects

operating_notes.text: Subsidiary Ananta Landmarks received a reduced net GST demand of ₹4.01 Cr for FY22.
Q4 FY26 pre-sales stood at ₹1,833 crore and collections at ₹1,487 crore.
Board approved a composite scheme of arrangement for demerging Korum Mall into KPTPL and amalgamating five subsidiaries into Kalpataru Limited.
Monitoring agency report states ₹1,579.06 Cr of ₹1,590 Cr IPO proceeds utilized as of March 31, 2026.
Secured development agreement for redevelopment of Shri Mahalakshmi Cooperative Housing Society in Andheri West with estimated GDV of ₹1,400 crores.
Signed a cluster redevelopment project in Kandivali East comprising five societies across ~2.8 acres with an estimated GDV of ₹1,250 crore.
Executive Committee approved the withdrawal of the Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of Project Magnus from Kalpataru Properties Limited.

holders.name: Gss India Opportunities AIF - Scheme I

timeline.summary: Kalpataru issued corporate guarantees totaling ₹790 Cr to ICICI Bank for subsidiaries Agile Real Estate Private Limited and Agile Real Estate Dev Private Limited on April 30, 2026.
Subsidiary Ananta Landmarks received an appellate GST order of ₹4.01 Cr for FY22, lower than the initial ₹5.49 Cr demand.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,693.73 Cr (+183.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹200.47 Cr (+1326.8% YoY).
Kalpataru reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,694 Cr (+184% YoY) and FY26 pre-sales of ₹5,280 Cr, with net debt to equity improving to 2.0x.
Kalpataru's board approved a composite scheme of arrangement for the demerger of Korum Mall and amalgamation of five subsidiaries on May 12, 2026.
Kalpataru reported ₹1,579.06 Cr utilized out of ₹1,590 Cr IPO proceeds as of March 31, 2026.

Gajendra Mewara, Chairman of Kalpataru Limited, concluded the Earnings Conference Call with analysts and investors on May 13, 2026, at 10:40 a.m. (IST) discussing audited financial results and quarterly developments.
Kalpataru reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,694 Cr and FY26 pre-sales of ₹5,280 Cr during its earnings call on May 13, 2026.
Kalpataru signed a cluster redevelopment project in Kandivali East, Mumbai, with an estimated GDV of ₹1,250 crore.
Kalpataru Limited withdrew its scheme of arrangement for the demerger of Project Magnus from its step-down subsidiary on June 2, 2026.
Kalpataru Properties Limited received a ₹73.85 Cr GST show-cause demand notice for FY 2025-26 construction services.

Kalpataru Limited will host an earnings conference call for investors and analysts on Friday, October 30, 2026 at 10:00 A.M. (IST) to discuss the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
